initial_finding.summary: Physical-return finalization originally accepted generic H17 1,1 state without proving that enable, latch, and evidence-run belonged to the current journal intent.
initial_finding.closure: The finalizer now reads only the exact enable, latch, and evidence-run identities; requires one shared 64-hex intent; compares all three exact expected byte hashes to the current record-1 SHA256; and performs this proof before crash-prefix reconstruction or final health.

followup_finding.summary: Fresh connected preflight stopped before native reads because the shared health helper's legacy allowlist ended at H15 and rejected the exact H16 predecessor.
followup_finding.closure: The H17 runner now issues only fixed framed version, status, and selftest reads and applies the existing exact receipt validator to the pinned H16 version and build; all five H16-current-health paths use this local check without widening the shared identity allowlist.
